records.contents: Proper subgroups, crystal systems and invariant dimensions for the eleven centrosymmetric classes.
Five percentiles of idealized piezoelectric norms, per run and averaged across seeds.
Flag percentages and median norms by point group, backbone, geometry and weight state.
Rutile displacement, space group and tensor norm for each run and mean across seeds.
Per-run MAE and constants, selected epochs and checkpoint digests, mean and sample SD, and percentage reduction relative to the best constant.
Selected and final training-zero flag rates, unseen-crystal flag rates and held-out MAE by loss weight.
GMTNet and CEITNet flags, medians and maxima for both geometries, masks and norm conventions. Rates are fractions.
Allocated parameter counts for both tensor targets and symmetry arms.
QM9 test MAE mean and sample SD for energy (eV) and dipole (D).
NumPy arrays of held-out coefficients, symmetry norms, external-model tensors and initialization norms.
EquiformerV3, eSEN and UMA initialization norms by crystal family and rates above 1% of the noncubic median.
Idealized-crystal norms and flag fractions before and after inversion antisymmetrization.
Material identifiers linking the crystal classes and independent initialization cohort. Empty entries indicate absence from that cohort.
Share of zero-predictor squared error in the largest piezoelectric training tensors.
Training configurations, file hashes, dataset paths and numerical software versions.
